stem: Which of the following is an example of using a renewable resource to generate electricity?

options.label: A
options.text: Building pipelines to maximize the efficiency of transporting oil and gas

options.label: B
options.text: Placing large wind turbines in areas with strong, steady winds

options.label: C
options.text: Using hydraulic fracturing with water and sand to release oil and gas

options.label: D
options.text: Conducting open-pit mining in areas where coal is found near the surface
